tickets.title: Review test quality and run full sandbox unit suite and resolve failures
tickets.body:
## Context
Sole final Test Writer after settled source and all shared test work. This subtask is outside the coverage lane.

## What Needs to Change
Run make test-sandbox; repair test/fixture failures, route production failures to Engineer and rerun focused checks. Repeat the full suite only when corrections or failures justify it.

## Key Files
- Makefileexistinginvocation; changedtestfixtureowners.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Exact revision and complete Go/Bun totals are green or honestly blocked. No host artifacts, authenticated Cursor, real AD stores, Docker integration or TLC execution. No integration-execution subtask.

Relay settlement retires the relay controller and all its queued responses, including allow and deny; it does not resolve a genuinely open connected native request. A deliberate fallen-back pane answer may use the same request arbiter, but terminal timeout/cancellation cannot revive a request and uncertain relay approval is never replayed as a pane answer. Failed/missing acknowledgement means zero relay ACP replies, including timeout denial: use separately validated cancellation or truthful bounded failure/fallback, never disguise a denial as cancellation. Preserve conservative holds until valid proof or owning-spawn end.
Review changed tests against the test-guide quality checklist. Final full units follow settled documentation and any required literal-advice assertion synchronization; retain earlier focused results, never manufacture a run against intentionally stale pins.
